name: Lode #767
description: Lode — 5,555 mineable rocks on BNB Chain. Each rock hides a mineral: Iron, Quartz, Copper, Gold, or Diamond. Hold a rock and it mines $MINE every day — 100 $MINE x power per day, claimable on-chain. First mint FREE for Agent ID holders, then 0.0006 BNB. Forge lower minerals up the ladder: 3 Iron to 1 Quartz, 2 Quartz to 1 Copper, 2 Copper to 1 Gold, 2 Gold to 1 Diamond.
